decisions.rationale: Only the first name RITA is shared; side A has no surname or partner, and the Hungarian flag is a weak country match for a common name.
RITA is the first word of RITA SZABO and both carry a Hungarian flag, but side A has no surname or partner to confirm the link.
Rita & Eddy and Rita Szabo have different partners in the events shown (Eddy vs Chris da White) and no shared event, so the evidence neither joins nor splits them.
Both records are Romeo with partner Laura (Romeo & Laura; Roméo Bachata and Laura), the same first name and partner across two France events.
DJ Ronaldo and Ronaldo & Sarah appear at the same festival on the same date with the same style (ZOUK) and stated country, matching the DJ-prefix pattern.
Ronie & Frida and Ronie Saleh share only the first name and a stated Sweden flag; no partner, style or shared event links them.
All records are DJs in France under one stage name (Safir Beats / Safir's Beats) in spelling and punctuation variants only.
Said (solo) and Said & Oksana share the first name and a stated France flag, but no shared event or partner on the solo side confirms it.
Said and Said DStreet share the first name and France flag, but the solo records give no partner or event overlap to join or split them.
Said Mr Battle Kiz is a single event record whose suffix does not appear in Said's events, so the first name and France flag alone do not settle it.
Said & Oksana and Saïd Dstreet & Oksana share the first name and the partner Oksana, and both carry a France flag.
Said & Oksana and Said Mr Battle Kiz share a first name and a France flag and both link to Battle Kizz events, but no partner or shared event confirms identity.
SAMAT and SAMAT & KATE are the same distinctive name with the same Kazakhstan flag, differing only by a partner.
Esteban & Sandra and Selim & Sandra share a first name and Spanish nationality, but their partners differ and no event is shared.
Sandra G is a solo record whose initial gives no surname to compare, and the Esteban & Sandra record has no surname, so only a common first name and Spain connect them.
Selim & Sandra and Sandra G share only a common first name and Spain; no event, partner or surname links them.
Sani and Sani Groove share a first name and the Czech flag, but the styles and events do not overlap.
Sani and Sani Pragkizer share a first name and a Czech country hint, but the stage name is the only link and no event overlaps.
Akram & Sara and Sara Paxolieta share the partner Akram in the SUNKIZ listing (Akram Bouchiba & Sara Paxolieta), with the same first name and a Switzerland country hint.
Sara and Sara Martins appear at the same festival and country, but a first-name-only record beside a fuller name at one festival leaves two Saras possible.
Fanio & Sara and Juninho & Sara are couples with different partners and no shared event; a common first name and Angola/Portugal hints are too weak.
Fanio & Sara and Renato y Sara have different partners and no shared event; the Portugal flag and common first name are too weak.
Jack & Sara and Marco & Sara are both listed at Bachaturo Festival 2026 on the same date with different partners, so they are two different dancers named Sara.
Juninho & Sara and Val'R & Sara have different partners and no shared event; the common first name is weak evidence.
Vilmar and Sara and Sara Corpino share a first name and an Italy flag, but side A gives no surname to compare and no event overlaps.
Vilmar and Sara and Sara Iacobacci share a first name and an Italy flag only; no surname, partner or shared event settles it.
Vilmar and Sara and Sara Lecis share a first name and an Italy flag only; side A has no surname to compare with Lecis.
Py & Sarah and Sarah & Stef have different partners and no shared event; the common first name is weak evidence.
Py & Sarah and Val'R & Sarah are both listed at Tamasha Summer Kizomba Carnaval on the same date with different partners, so they are different dancers.
Sarah & Stef and Val'R & Sarah have different partners and no shared event; the common first name is weak evidence.
Nuno & Sarai and Sarai Navalon share the distinctive first name Sarai and a Spain flag, but side A has no style or surname to confirm a match.
Selim & Anastasia and Selim (solo) share a first name and a France hint only, with no shared event or surname.
Selim & Anastasia and Sélim & Kiki have different partners and share only the first name.
Selim (solo) and Sélim & Kiki share a first name and a France-related hint only; no event or surname links them.
Senseï and Senseï Uchiwa share a stage-name root, but side A has no surname and the stated countries (France, Spain) disagree.
Elsa & Sergi and Sergio & Elena have different partners (Elsa vs Elena) and different spellings of the first name, in different cities, so they are two couples.
Andrea & Silvia and Andreas & Silvia share the partner Silvia and an Italy hint, but Andrea and Andreas are one letter apart and not confirmed as one person.
Simicala (DJ) and Simicala Cunha & Katy are at the same festival on the same date with the same stated countries and the same stage name.
Sim Kiz and Sim Kizz are one stage name in a spelling variant, both teachers in Germany.
Simon & Lolahontas and Simone & Jennifer have different partners and genuinely different names one letter apart.
Sinah & Patrick and Patrick & Sinah Frenchkizz share the partner Patrick and the first name Sinah, both in Germany.
Sink and DJ Sink are at the same festival on the same date with the same stated country and the same stage name.
Sol and Sol Hissirou share a first name, the Bachata style and overlapping stated countries (France, UK).
Martina & Sónia and Stef Kizz & Sonia have different partners and no shared event; the common first name is weak evidence.
Richard & Sonia and Steff & Sonia have different partners and no shared event; the common first name is weak evidence.
Richard & Sonia and Stef Kizz & Sonia have different partners and no shared event; the common first name is weak evidence.
Steff & Sonia and Stef Kizz & Sonia share Sonia as partner and the same partner name in a spelling variant (Steff / Stef Kizz).
Steeve Bakoula and Steve Bakoula are a spelling variant of one distinctive full name, both teachers in France.
Sarah & Stef and Stef Kizz & Sonia share only the first name Stef; the partners differ and no event is shared.
Sonia & Stef and Stef Kizz & Sonia share the partner Sonia and the first name Stef, with the Kizz suffix as the only difference.
